articles.title: Yahoo Fantasy Death Leagues 101: How to play and win in this exciting format
articles.summary: Death Leagues are back on Yahoo fantasy football. Here's the 101.
articles.body:
We're thrilled to start another season of Yahoo Fantasy Death Leagues for 2026 . In this killer fantasy football game, fans compete for survival every week.

Create a private Death League or join a public one for the 2026 NFL season

Death Leagues offer a different approach from most fantasy leagues by removing the head-to-head matchups and replacing them with a weekly battle royale between all managers, where the team with the lowest total score for that week is eliminated.

To make things even more interesting, the entire roster of players from the team that gets knocked out goes to the waiver wire — where everyone will have a chance to bid on them.

That process continues week after week until one team is left standing and that lone surviving manager is crowned the winner.

To put it simply, Death Leagues combine the best parts of fantasy drafting and waiver wire adds, with an undeniable urgency to survive every single week. Instead of trying to win against one opponent, your goal is to avoid being the worst team in the league each week in order to escape elimination.

As long as you're not at the very bottom, you keep playing.

For private leagues, the default is 18 teams vying for the title, ending in Week 17. Private leagues can decide how many teams to play with and when to start. Public leagues consist of 14 teams and will play for 13 weeks.

However, you can begin a Death League with as few as four teams. Just know that fewer teams means a shorter fantasy season for your league.

And if you don't set your draft up before Week 1 — no worries! You can start your league anytime up until Week 15.

What are the lineup and rosters requirements?

While there are a lot of differences between season-long fantasy football leagues and Death League formats, this is one area where you'll feel right at home.

Here's a closer look at the roster breakdown:

One thing to note is that Death Leagues tend to feature more teams, as long as you start early in the year. This is important because there's a big difference in the players available during the later rounds of a 12-team league versus an 18-teamer.

So if you're starting in Week 1, keep that in mind when you're looking at your roster in the opening month. At that point in the season, everyone has question marks in their lineups.

This is another area that will be very familiar to fantasy managers, since the scoring settings are the same as you would have in many other formats.

-Fewest cumulative -Fewest points from a starter, 2nd, 3rd, etc.

-Fewest points from a starter, 2nd, 3rd, etc.

As always, make sure you go over the scoring before you draft so that you're well prepared to take players that fit this format.

Now, here's where strategy comes into play even more.

All managers will begin the season with $1,000 and you'll make a decision on how much of that budget you want to put towards acquiring a specific player before waivers are processed.

But the biggest difference between traditional fantasy leagues and the Death League format is the quality of free agents available each week. For example, if the team with Ja'Marr Chase finished last in Week 1 — then Chase will be up for grabs on the waiver wire before Week 2.

By the end of the season, the remaining teams will be completely stacked with stars, which means the incoming crop of players from the losing roster will be that much more impressive every week.

So, it's important to make sure you save some FAB for the stretch run if you hope to finish the season as the champion.

What are some general strategies for Death Leagues?

Navigating the nuances of Death Leagues offers a new challenge for fantasy managers.

We'll go over some of the specific strategies with more detail in other articles, but here's a quick look at some of the approaches you'll want to consider for this format.

Since your main goal is to make it through each week, most of your focus needs to be on the present. If you look too far ahead, you could find yourself eliminated from the league before you even make it to those future scenarios.

You'll also have plenty of opportunities to bolster your roster through the waiver wire as the season progresses, thanks to the higher quality free agents who will become available on a weekly basis. So, don't worry about the later stages of the campaign until you get closer to it.

Get ready for Yahoo Fantasy Death Leagues

While traditional redraft leagues reward chasing upside, Death League formats give a boost in value to players with high floors who can be trusted to give you steady production — even if they don't offer a massive fantasy ceiling.

This is especially true in the early part of the season, when there will be lots of teams that will be on the verge of getting eliminated because one or two of their stars had a bad week. It might feel odd, but trusting stable, high-floor veterans can be the difference between advancing or going home in the first couple months.

Projecting fantasy strength of schedule can be a dangerous game, since so much can change over the course of an NFL season. Narrowing your focus to the early part of the campaign has always been the best use of strength of schedule and that's even more important in Death Leagues.

If you draft a star player who has a tough string of opponents in the first few weeks , their production might be underwhelming and your season might come to an early end. On the flip side, if a player has a softer slate in September they might provide more value than other managers realize. So, keep a close eye on the early matchups for the players you're drafting.

Early bye weeks can be an insurmountable obstacle for your lineup, if you don't factor them into your build. Stars with early byes lose some of their value in this format and often end up on the waiver wire after those weeks because their managers get eliminated.

You also want to pay close attention so you don't have too many players on bye during the same week in the first half of the season. Having players on bye in the second half of the year is also not ideal, but you'll have plenty of time to change your roster before those problem weeks arrive.

Balancing the risk/reward for volatile fantasy options is a key part of most redraft leagues. Seeing past red flags and hitting on the right player could change your season.

However, in Death Leagues, that is a much more dangerous proposition. Avoiding risk at the start of the season is usually the much better approach.

An injury to a high-end running back could decimate your lineup in Death Leagues, so insulating your backfield against potential injuries is a more useful plan in this format.

If you're going to take a running back in the early rounds, keep their backup on your radar in the later rounds of drafts — or at worst on your watchlist if they go undrafted.

With so many teams with varying levels of success throughout the season, the desperation is real when it comes to the waiver wire.

If a manager just barely avoided last place the week before, you can be sure their bids will be aggressive in an attempt to vault themselves away from the danger zone. Try to look at your leaguemates' rosters to get a feel for how they might attack their bids that week.

While the excitement of seeing superstar names on the waiver wire might make you want to do everything in your power to add them, you have to remember it's a long season in Death Leagues.

If you don't save some of your budget for the final stretch, you'll be powerless against opponents who still have money in the bank when the player pool is loaded near the end.

If you survive long enough, your team will be stacked and there will be plenty of talent available. When you get to the point where every remaining roster is brimming with stars, you'll want to make sure to increase your focus on matchups again.

Just because a player is a household name, doesn't necessarily mean they're in the best position to keep you alive in the final month. Your path to a title may very well come down to which star capitalizes on a generous defense in a given week.

As the season goes along, you'll get a sense of how your team compares to other rosters in the league. While you might be able to wait things out in more typical redraft leagues, you cannot take that risk in Death Leagues. You have to address weaknesses as soon as you identify them.

If you find your team is coasting near the top early in the season, then you can take advantage and plan a little bit further ahead than your opponents in an effort to set yourself up for the long haul towards a Death League championship.

articles.title: How the Premier League transfer market has exploded
articles.summary: Has the football transfer market lost the plot? Sky Sports looks into why Premier League fees are soaring and if the trend is here to stay...
articles.body:
A trend started by Jack Grealish's £100m move from Aston Villa to Manchester City in 2021 has created a domino effect, establishing a new benchmark for elite Premier League talent that continues to send records tumbling.

Fees since have begun to accelerate far beyond general market inflation, with the average price for dipping into the premium player pool doubling over the past decade.

This clear acceleration has been particularly apparent over the past three years. Between 2016-2023, average top-end costs held relatively steady. They fluctuated to a degree but not with the disparity we see now.

Following on from Grealish, the idea of a £100m-plus investment became more normalised.

His sale, and to an extent that of Romelu Lukaku (£97.5m) around the same time, marked a clear tipping point in the sharp rise of the top-end market.

Those transfers helped pave the way for subsequent nine-figure deals involving Enzo Fernandez and Moises Caicedo to Chelsea, as well as Declan Rice to Arsenal - all in 2023.

Such deals effectively reinforce one another, made more possible because Premier League clubs are richer and more greatly resourced than ever before.

Broadcast income, sponsorships and commercial revenues continue to dwarf most other European leagues.

Even mid-table Premier League clubs often generate more revenue than Champions League clubs elsewhere in Europe, thus increasing spending power but also strengthening negotiating positions.

Most Premier League clubs are no longer under pressure to sell their best players to balance the books.

The idea that the so-called 'top six' can force sales out of smaller clubs is less applicable in an era of high-wealth owners and greater financial gains, albeit this summer has witnessed somewhat of a resurgence of 'big clubs' raiding 'small clubs'.

Still, the strength of bargaining power has also been leveraged to drive prices higher.

Last summer saw moves for Florian Wirtz (£116.5m) and Alexander Isak (£125m) to Liverpool, while this window has witnessed major sums spent on Elliot Anderson (£116m), Sandro Tonali (£100m), Morgan Rogers (£117m) and Ayyoub Bouaddi (£85.6m).

Those moves have sent top-end averages soaring, up from £38.6m in 2024/25 to £59.8m in 2026/27.

Contextually, Barcelona's £65.4m fee for Rodri is bang on trend for a top-end player in this current market, but his age and remaining contract length would suggest the Spanish club have overpaid against the average.

In short, yes, albeit certain criteria need to be met. The most obvious metric being a Premier League-proven player. Wirtz and Fernandez are the only two exceptions to that rule. Peak age (23-26) is also a major consideration.

Paul Pogba was signed by Man United for £93.25m in 2016 but that transfer, for the time, was a complete anomaly.

The Premier League now has a growing list of deals in the £100m region, despite there being revenue-linked spending rules. Those clubs with huge incomes are still free to invest heavily.

Often, the terms of such deals allow clubs to spread payments over multiple financial years, making the accounting more manageable. And therefore more likely to reoccur.

£100m-plus fees might be the reserve of the Premier League's top clubs for now, but they have become far closer to the norm than the exception.

articles.title: Enciso, la gran esperanza en ataque para la salvación del Ipswich Town
articles.standfirst: El atacante paraguayo ya militó en el conjunto inglés en la segunda mitad del curso 24/25
articles.summary: El atacante paraguayo ya militó en el conjunto inglés en la segunda mitad del curso 24/25
articles.body: El Ipswich Town sigue haciendo los deberes con la misión de lograr la permanencia en su segundo ascenso consecutivo a Premier League. Y con esa misión, los 'Tractor Boys' han oficializado este lunes la incorporación de un futbolista diferencial en ataque: Julio Enciso.  El delantero paraguayo, capitán general en su selección durante el Mundial, deja el Estrasburgo apenas una temporada después de firmar por el equipo satélite del Chelsea (que también lo pretendió durante este verano) y regresa al conjunto inglés, donde ya jugó en la segunda mitad de la temporada 24/25 cedido por el Brighton.  Enciso viene de sumar 12 goles y 9 asistencias en el conjunto alsaciano en el último curso y sus características futbolísticas suponen un salto de nivel en la parcela ofensiva del Ipswich Town, que paga cerca de los 30 millones de euros, incluidos bonus, por el atacante sudamericano.  “Estoy muy feliz de estar de vuelta en el Ipswich Town. Disfruté mucho mi tiempo cedido en el club y me alegró muchísimo verlos ascender a la Premier League la temporada pasada. Trabajé con el entrenador en Francia la temporada pasada y la oportunidad de volver a jugar para él en un gran club como el Ipswich es algo que me ilusiona mucho. Tengo muchas ganas de volver a ver a los aficionados", ha afirmado Enciso en su presentación como nuevo jugador del equipo inglés.

articles.title: Lampard ya tiene nuevo '9'
articles.standfirst: El Coventry ficha a Taiwo Awoniyi por 10,5 kilos procedente del Nottingham
articles.summary: El Coventry ficha a Taiwo Awoniyi por 10,5 kilos procedente del Nottingham
articles.body: El Coventry sigue reforzándose de cara a su regreso a la máxima categoría del fútbol inglés, que no pisa desde la temporada 2000-01. El conjunto dirigido por Frank Lampard logró un ascenso histórico tras sumar 95 puntos y volver así a la Premier League, donde busca consolidarse. El técnico inglés ya tiene un '9' para pelear por la permanencia tras pagar 10,5 millones de euros por Taiwo Awoniyi, procedente del Nottingham Forest. Con la incorporación del delantero nigeriano, los 'Sky Blues' ya acumulan siete fichajes en lo que va de mercado estival y continúan dando forma a una plantilla con la que afrontar su regreso a la élite. El delantero nigeriano se suma a las opciones ofensivas de Haji Wright, Ellis Simms y Thomas-Asante, responsables de 43 de los 97 goles que llevaron al Coventry al ascenso. Awoniyi es, además, la última incorporación de un mercado muy activo para el Coventry, que ya han firmado a Caleb Yirenkyi (Nordsjælland, 27 millones), Carl Rushworth (Brighton, 25,7 millones), Loum Tchaouna (Burnley, 23 millones), Aurèle Amenda (Eintracht Frankfurt, 18 millones), Gustavo Hammer (Sheffield United, 7 millones) y Frank Onyeka (Brentford, 7 millones). Con estos fichajes, el recién ascendido ya ha invertido 118 millones. Tras una gran primera temporada en los 'Tricky Trees', en la que anotó 10 goles en liga, su protagonismo fue disminuyendo progresivamente en las campañas posteriores, tanto en minutos como en cifras goleadoras. Ahora, bajo las órdenes de Lampard, se muestra con ganas de relanzar su carrera. "Tengo muchas ganas de trabajar con mis nuevos compañeros. He visto lo increíbles que estuvieron la temporada pasada tras ascender desde la Championship, fueron fantásticos. Ahora estoy muy ilusionado por unirme a ellos y empezar la nueva temporada", afirmó el atacante.

articles.title: El Man. City, muy cerca de comprar por 100 'kilos' a un 'Rodri de 18 años'
articles.standfirst: El internacional marroquí Bouaddi podría ser el acompañante de Elliot Anderson en el once de Maresca
articles.summary: El internacional marroquí Bouaddi podría ser el acompañante de Elliot Anderson en el once de Maresca
articles.body: Ayyoub Bouaddi. Ése es el nombre del mediocentro que está a punto de entrar en la nómina del Manchester City, que intenta así reaccionar a la pérdida del ya barcelonista Rodri Hernández. El City, tras perder la Community Shield el domingo ante el Arsenal (3-0), intenta así recomponer un centro del campo ya reforzado este verano con Elliot Anderson (135 millones de euros). En teoría, Bouaddi (más posicional) y Anderson (’box to box’) conformarían el nuevo doble pivote de Enzo Maresca. No va a costar mucho menos (100 millones de euros, 85 de libras) este chico, Bouaddi, nacido en Francia (Senlis, 2 de octubre de 2007). Fue internacional galo en todas las inferiores (hasta Sub 20 y Sub 21), pero, en enero de este año, decidió representar a Marruecos (por origen familiar), Selección con la que hizo un grandísimo Mundial (titular en cinco de los seis partidos del país). Bouaddi siempre fue un talento precoz, desde que debutó en el Lille con 16 años y tres días en octubre de 2023, superando en precocidad incluso a Eden Hazard en ese equipo. En el Lille ha participado en tres campañas con un rol esencial para que el club fuera tercero la temporada pasada. Ahora, con 18 años aún, parece preparado para dar un salto gigante hacia la Premier League. Los aficionados del Real Madrid podrán recordar a este chico de la derrota madridista en la Champions 2024 (1-0) ante el Lille. Ese día Boauddi, con 17 años, hizo un gran partido ante los Tchouaméni, Valverde, Camavinga y compañía. La categoría de Bouaddi está fuera de toda duda. Así lo describió su compañero Olivier Giroud hace unas semanas: “Me recuerda a Vieira y Busquets. Todavía no está al nivel técnico de Sergio y tal vez le falte un poco de potencia para compararlo con Vieira. Se pondrá más fuerte y más grande, pero es un jugador completo, muy versátil, y está por todas partes, un poco como Kanté. Lo único que debería mejorar y tiene que mejorar es su definición, ser más agresivo frente al arco”. El City ficharía a un potencial crack... y ojo porque tampoco se descarta que también vaya a por Enzo Fernández (Chelsea)... por otros 100 millones de euros ‘largos’. Se viene un gran City.

articles.title: Destapan las grandes broncas y obsesiones de Guardiola en el City: de su divorcio a los abrazos forzados
articles.standfirst: Pep Guardiola se sincera en la nueva docuserie de Amazon Prime: abrazos forzados, broncas en el vestuario y el momento en que la directiva del Manchester City empezó a perder la fe
articles.summary: Pep Guardiola se sincera en la nueva docuserie de Amazon Prime: abrazos forzados, broncas en el vestuario y el momento en que la directiva del Manchester City empezó a perder la fe
articles.body: El documental 'A Beautiful Obsession' (Una Hermosa Obsesión) de Prime Vídeo profundiza en las interioridades de los dos últimos años del entrenador español Pep Guardiola al frente del Manchester City, equipo que dirigió con éxito durante una década (de 2016 a 2026). En el documental de cuatro episodios se revela que Pep Guardiola, que renovó con el City en noviembre de 2024, era consciente de que los 'citizens' necesitaban un cambio. El entrenador español, que en ese momento le propuso a la directiva salir, decidió renovar para no dejar al City en la estacada en medio de una crisis de malos resultados y supervisar la renovación durante 18 meses más. "En aquel momento, la verdad es que no estaba seguro de poder convencerte", reconoce el presidente Khaldoon Al Mubarak en 'Una Bonita Obsesión'. En el documental se cuenta que en septiembre de 2025, en las semanas previas a una gran victoria en el derbi de Mánchester (tras haber sufrido derrotas consecutivas ante el Tottenham y el Brighton), Guardiola se obsesionó con que sus jugadores se abrazaran. "Mirad, mirad cómo lo hacéis en los entrenamientos. ¿Hicisteis eso en Brighton? Mirad cómo celebráis. Estamos en este jodido negocio para eso. ¿Sentís la presión? Joder, de eso se trata. Es bueno sentirla; si no, estaríamos todos en las Maldivas", reprende Guardiola entre gritos a sus jugadores, a lo que les recrimina no haber celebrado con suficiente entusiasmo un gol de Haaland. El 'Daily Mail' reproduce que antes de salir a enfrentarse al Manchester United, Guardiola exigió a todos que "se abrazaran durante cinco segundos, bien fuerte" para buscar la cohesión del grupo. El City ganó 3-0 al United. "La victoria de hoy nace de los abrazos de antes... Los abrazos no fueron fuertes. Yo lo intenté, pero vosotros no me devolvisteis el abrazo con la misma intensidad. Los quiero más fuertes. Fuertes y que duren más tiempo. Quiero que sintáis mi compromiso con vosotros. Estoy muy orgulloso de vosotros; este es el comienzo de lo que os aseguro que será una gran temporada", apuntó Pep. En noviembre de 2025 Pep Guardiola les dedicó un descarnado discurso a sus jugadores tras perder 0-2 contra el Bayer Leverkusen en Champions, en un partido en el que realizó 10 cambios para tener a todos sus jugadores motivados. "¡Joder, chicos! Todos tenéis que sentir esa mentalidad de 'voy a demostrarles que soy el mejor, voy a demostrarle a este puto entrenador de mierda que soy mejor que los otros'. Es una competición entre vosotros, ¿y dónde ha estado esa competición hoy? Me siento triste. Me siento decepcionado conmigo mismo por las cosas increíblemente estúpidas que intento hacer para que os sintáis seguros, protegidos y con confianza. Me siento un puto estúpido. Llegué aquí a las ocho de la mañana, chicos. Pasé horas y horas intentando encontrar la manera de llegar a vuestro corazón. A vuestro corazón. Y cuando no lo consigo, es frustrante a nivel personal. No me devolvéis nada, chicos. ¿Sabéis qué va a pasar? Tendréis otro entrenador. Como vea una sola puta cara de tristeza al final de la temporada, os mato. Como vea vuestra puta cara quejándoos de algo cuando tomo decisiones, os mato, joder... Trabajad más duro, trabajad mejor, vivid mejor", les dijo decepcionado el de Santpedor a sus jugadores. Guardiola les apuntó en el vestuario a los futbolistas del Manchester city que "se pueden perder partidos —y os defiendo muchas veces—, pero es inaceptable esta falta de coraje, de pasión, de amor y de ganas de ganar. Cuando os saludo, me saludáis. Cuando os abrazo, me abrazáis. Yo vivo mi vida, mi divorcio... y mi familia está lejos por todos vosotros. ¿Y qué recibo a cambio? La puta actuación que habéis hecho, todos vosotros. Es una vergüenza, chicos. Joder, estoy realmente jodidamente harto. Cuando veo eso, me siento agotado. Vacío. Quiero dejarlo. Me siento solo. Cuando jugáis así, me siento solo. Mañana no me veréis. Que paséis dos días estupendos. Yo voy a salir ante los medios para defenderos". El diario 'The Sun' amplía que en el documental le comunicó a los jugadores del Manchester City su separación matrimonial de Cristina Serra durante esa charla técnica cargada de furia, en la que les exigió mostrar la "pasión" que él había perdido. "Muchachos, quiero confesarles algo... Estoy divorciado de la mujer más hermosa del planeta. Es mi esposa... mi exesposa. La amo increíblemente. Pero perdimos la pasión. Por muchas razones, perdimos la pasión. La amo profundamente. Ella me quiere, sí, pero perdimos la pasión. Y así es como se juega al fútbol: juegas por algo que llevas dentro, pero ¿dónde está la pasión? En la vida, hagas lo que hagas, hazlo con pasión. No quiero buenos jugadores, quiero jugadores con pasión", se sinceró el técnico del City.  En del documental se descubre que Al Mubarak y el director ejecutivo Ferran Soriano intercambian notas de voz responsabilizando a Pep Guardiola del desastre contra el Leverkusen. Soriano a Al Mubarak: "Creo que nuestra actitud hacia Pep no debería ser demasiado negativa. Eso no funciona con él. Pero tampoco debería ser demasiado amable o condescendiente. Esta vez, el error es suyo". Al Mubarak a Soriano: "Alinear un equipo totalmente nuevo en un partido tan importante es probablemente uno de nuestros momentos más bajos. Sinceramente, no puedo hablar con él. No hablé con él ayer ni le envié ningún mensaje. Estoy muy enfadado. Ha hecho una mezcla totalmente innecesaria". En mayo de 2026, dos días antes del último partido de la temporada, Pep Guardiola presentó un último vídeo a sus jugadores y pronunció un último discurso como entrenador del Manchester City. El entrenador español utiliza un montaje de imágenes de toda la década acompañado de un mensaje pregrabado, en el que cita al poeta Tony Walsh, que se proyectará a los aficionados tras la derrota ante el Aston Villa ese mismo fin de semana. "Chicos, seré breve. El domingo será mi último partido como entrenador de este club. La razón es sencilla: para ir a Selhurst Park, a Anfield, a jugar contra equipos de League One en la FA Cup —o enfrentarse al Madrid, Madrid, Madrid— y para lidiar con los jugadores maravillosos que tenemos, hace falta algo que yo tenía: energía. Pero, en el fondo, sé que ya no la tengo. Me marcho sintiendo una gratitud y una felicidad inmensas hacia todos vosotros. En unos minutos, la afición se enterará de mi partida y, antes de que eso ocurra, merecéis ser los primeros en escuchar algo que creo que vale más que mis palabras. Necesito vuestros abrazos y besos. No lo olvidéis", dijo Pep en un emotivo discurso.

articles.title: Las lágrimas de Guardiola en su guerra con el capitán infiel que le desgastó en el City: "¿Qué habéis hecho?"
articles.standfirst: Kyle Walker afirma que Guardiola nunca lo quiso como capitán durante una acalorada discusión en el Manchester City, según se ve en un documental de Prime Video
articles.summary: Kyle Walker afirma que Guardiola nunca lo quiso como capitán durante una acalorada discusión en el Manchester City, según se ve en un documental de Prime Video
articles.body: El documental 'A Beautiful Obsession' (Una Hermosa Obsesión) de Prime Vídeo, en el que destapan las grandes broncas y obsesiones de los últimos tiempos de Pep Guardiola en el Manchester City, saca a la luz el conflicto entre el entrenador español y el controvertido Kyle Walker (que durante su etapa en el City estuvo salpicado por escándalos sexuales (infidelidades, prostitución, exposición indecente) y su doble vida ("tiene dos familias"). Pep Guardiola, comunicó a sus jugadores que se sentía "increíblemente triste" porque el capitán, Kyle Walker, había pedido marcharse del club (en enero de 2025 acabó cedido en el AC Milan). En una escena emotiva se ve al técnico español diciendo a los jugadores que "no se puede actuar" como lo hizo Walker, por el que el City pagó más de 60 millones de euros al Tottenham en 2017. "Qué triste lo que pasó con Kyle... Le habría resultado muy fácil venir a verme y decirme: 'Estoy cansado'. Pero un capitán no puede comportarse como él lo hizo. No se puede, y menos en los momentos más difíciles de nuestras vidas", comenta antes de un partido en casa contra el Chelsea. "¿Qué habéis hecho, amigos míos? ¿Qué habéis hecho con vuestro capitán? Decidme, ¿qué habéis hecho?", le preguntó Guardiola a sus jugadores del City tras el conflicto con Kyle Walker. Justo después de la discusión con Walker, el documental muestra a Pep Guardiola entre lágrimas mientras le dice a su equipo: "Si soy un problema, tenéis que decírmelo... "No me quedaré aquí solo por el dinero, o simplemente por el hecho de quedarme". "Renové el contrato porque quiero estar aquí con vosotros; quiero luchar estando en este puesto. No quiero sentir que me marcho y huyo de vosotros. No quiero tener la sensación de que todo se viene abajo. Pero si sentís —primero los capitanes y luego el resto— que hay un problema, decídmelo. Eso no cambiará el cariño que siento por todos vosotros, ni por un segundo. Pero quiero luchar. Eso es todo. Lo siento", aclaró el entrenador español. La relación entre Pep Guardiola y Kyle Walker empezó a enquistarse después de que ambos protagonizasen una discusión tras una derrota ante el Liverpool en Anfield en diciembre de 2004, en la que el lateral tuvo un erro garrafal. "Kyle tiene que saber que, si pierdes el balón, es gol", dice Guardiola en el vestuario tras el partido. "Si sigues mencionando mi nombre en cada reunión, en cada maldita cosa, va a ser imposible; vas a provocar una reacción... ¡Joder! En todas las putas reuniones sale mi nombre", replica Walker. La respuesta de Guardiola fue: "Quizás porque eres el capitán". "Vale, pero quizá no querías que fuera capitán. No querías que fuera tu capitán", contestó Walker. Tras su cesión en el Milan el internacional Kyle Walker jugó la pasada temporada 36 partidos con el Burnley.

articles.title: Una oferta de FutbolJobs destapa una misteriosa lista de la Premier
articles.standfirst: Una oferta publicada en FutbolJobs desvela la búsqueda de ocho perfiles para un club inglés, con un presupuesto potencial de 413 millones de euros y hasta 125 millones para un extremo derecho
articles.summary: Una oferta publicada en FutbolJobs desvela la búsqueda de ocho perfiles para un club inglés, con un presupuesto potencial de 413 millones de euros y hasta 125 millones para un extremo derecho
articles.body: Una oferta publicada en FutbolJobs abre una ventana poco habitual al mercado de fichajes de la Premier League. Una agencia internacional de representación asegura trabajar directamente con un club de la máxima categoría inglesa que busca jugadores para varias posiciones y fija, en algunos casos, presupuestos de hasta 125 millones de euros por futbolista. El club no aparece identificado en la oferta. Tampoco se trata de una convocatoria abierta de un equipo para incorporar jugadores sin más: el anuncio especifica que las peticiones proceden directamente de un club de la Premier y que están siendo gestionadas por una agencia internacional de representación. Y las cifras llaman especialmente la atención. Ocho perfiles y un presupuesto potencial de 413 millones  Si el club terminara incorporando un jugador para cada una de las ocho necesidades, la horquilla económica de las operaciones se situaría entre 225 y 413 millones de euros, sin incluir salarios, primas, comisiones u otros costes asociados a las operaciones. La cifra máxima equivale, por sí sola, a construir prácticamente una nueva columna vertebral de una plantilla de Premier. El dato más llamativo está en el extremo derecho El requisito establece un valor mínimo de mercado de 20 millones de euros según Transfermarkt, pero el presupuesto disponible para el traspaso se dispara hasta los 100-125 millones. La diferencia entre valor de mercado y precio potencial de compra no es un detalle menor. Transfermarkt recuerda que sus valores de mercado no son una predicción directa del precio de un fichaje: representan una estimación del valor del jugador en un mercado libre y tienen en cuenta, entre otros factores, las circunstancias particulares de cada operación. En otras palabras, la oferta no está buscando simplemente a un extremo cuyo valor de mercado ronde los 20 millones. Está dejando abierta la puerta a una operación de 100 millones o más. Para ponerlo en perspectiva, en la Premier ya se están produciendo operaciones de esta magnitud. Morgan Rogers ha llegado al Chelsea desde el Aston Villa por unos 117 millones de libras y Elliot Anderson ha aterrizado en el Manchester City por una cantidad reportada de 116 millones de libras. La gran incógnita es precisamente esa. La oferta no identifica al club de la Premier pero sí resulta posible, sin embargo, poner las exigencias en contexto con el mercado actual. La Premier continúa siendo, con enorme diferencia, la competición con mayor valor de mercado agregado. En la última gran actualización de Transfermarkt, de junio de 2026, el valor total de los jugadores de la liga alcanzaba los 12.370 millones de euros. Lo llamativo es que una petición publicada en un portal de empleo futbolístico permita conocer, aunque sea indirectamente, qué tipo de jugador está dispuesto a buscar un club de la Premier y cuánto dinero está preparado para poner encima de la mesa. Hay una diferencia enorme entre pedir un jugador con un valor de mercado de cinco millones y establecer que el traspaso puede alcanzar los 50 o 60 millones. Y todavía mayor cuando el perfil es un extremo derecho con un presupuesto de hasta 125 millones. El anuncio no significa que vayan a gastarse 413 millones. Hay una precaución importante. Los 413 millones de euros son el resultado de sumar los límites superiores de las ocho horquillas publicadas, no un presupuesto oficial anunciado por el club. Tampoco significa que el equipo vaya a fichar ocho jugadores, ni que vaya a pagar necesariamente el máximo previsto por cada uno. Lo que sí demuestra la oferta es que existe una búsqueda concreta de perfiles y que la agencia está autorizada, según el propio anuncio, a recibir candidaturas de jugadores y representantes que encajen en los criterios.

articles.title: Liverpool: Key questions answered as Amit Bhatia, Jeff Bezos and Eduardo Saverin agree purchase of strategic minority stake
articles.summary: Amazon founder Jeff Bezos is part of the Amit Bhatia-led consortium that has agreed to buy a stake in Liverpool; Sky News reports the group are buying around one third of the Reds in a deal valuing the club at more than $7bn (£5.2bn); we take a deep dive into what the deal could mean
articles.body:
The world's third richest person is part of the group fronted by former QPR co-owner Amit Bhatia. Facebook co-founder Eduardo Saverin is also part of the syndicate.

According to Sky News , the consortium has agreed to buy a roughly one-third stake in the club in a deal that values Liverpool at more than $7bn (£5.2bn). Closing of the transaction is subject to regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions.

We take a look at some of the key questions surrounding what the deal could look like...

The Bezos-backed consortium bought a 38 per cent stake in Liverpool from FSG.

It was initially suggested by sources close to the deal that the investment was for 30-33 per cent of the Premier League club.

However, Sky Sports News can confirm that 1892 Holdings has bought a stake closer to 40 per cent in Liverpool.

Sky Sports News reported last week that Liverpool's new minority investors have an option to become majority shareholders of the Premier League club.

According to Sky's US partner CNBC, this option is active for 12 months and would value Liverpool at around $8bn.

Sources have stressed the existence of such an agreement is not a guarantee of any future transaction.

Liverpool's statement last week said FSG continues to retain majority ownership and operational control of the club.

Bezos is one of the most famous businessmen in the world and the owner of e-commerce giant Amazon, which he founded in 1994 out of his Seattle garage.

His other investments include aerospace company Blue Origin and venture capital firm Nash Holdings, which is the ownership vehicle for The Washington Post.

Bhatia is a 46-year-old British Indian entrepreneur, who has an investment banking background.

He currently manages a multi-asset investment firm called AyBe Capital which invests in range of diversified sectors including technology, media, property and real estate, consumer retail and health.

Bhatia is married to Vanisha Mittal Bhatia, who is the daughter of Indian billionaire Lakshmi Mittal.

He leads and manages 1892 Holdings, the consortium that has agreed the minority investment in Liverpool with majority owners Fenway Sports Group.

Forbes estimates that Bezos' personal fortune is in the region of $281bn (£209bn), making him the third-richest person in the world behind Elon Musk and Google co-founder Larry Page.

It's unclear how much Bhatia himself is worth. But his father-in-law, billionaire steel magnate Lakshmi Mittal, is worth an estimated £23.2bn according to Forbes. That makes him the 72nd richest person in the world.

Bezos is a big American Football fan and has previously been reported to have explored bids for the Washington Commanders and the Seattle Seahawks.

He is not known to hold a significant stake in any other sports team or enterprise currently.

Bhatia was just 28 when he joined the board of directors and became vice-chairman of QPR in 2007 after the Mittal family bought a 20 per cent stake in QPR, joining Bernie Ecclestone and Flavio Briatore as investors in the London club.

He spent five years as QPR chairman between 2018 and 2023 and stayed on as a director and co-owner until earlier this week when he transferred his stake in the club to majority owner Ruben Gnanalingam.

Through AyBe capital, Bhatia is an investor in TGL - Rory McIlroy and Tiger Woods' golf league which fuses golf and technology and features six teams with some of the best players in the world in a season-long competition.

His firm also invests in Switch Hitter, which is a media brand founded by Kevin Pietersen, delivering exclusive interviews and content with the world's top cricketers.

Earlier this year, Bhatia's father-in-law acquired a 75 per cent stake in the Rajasthan Royals Indian Premier League cricket franchise.

FSG were under no pressure to sell but did indicate in 2022 that they were open to new investment in Liverpool, with the sale of a small stake to Dynasty Equity completed the following year.

Liverpool have enjoyed huge success under FSG, lifting every major trophy available to win.

FSG may think it is mission accomplished somewhat as far they are concerned, and therefore were amenable to fresh investment. They also stand to make a huge profit on their initial investment, with the deal for a 30 per cent stake worth more than five times what they paid for the entire club back in 2010.

Could the Bezos-backed group take over Liverpool?

Liverpool's new minority investors have an option to become majority shareholders of the Premier League club for a valuation of around $8bn in the next 12 months, according to Sky's US partner CNBC.

Sky Sports News has been told the agreement announced today includes a framework for future investment from the Jeff Bezos-backed consortium.

However, sources have stressed that the existence of such an agreement is not a guarantee of any future transaction.

Liverpool's statement says FSG continues to retain majority ownership and operational control of the club.

Liverpool are the fourth most valuable club in the world. The consortium's investment in Liverpool values the club somewhere in the region of £5.2bn ($7bn), making it one of the sport's richest-ever deals.

FSG have complete operational control of Liverpool, but private equity firms RedBird Capital and Arctos Sports Partners hold minority stakes in the club. Dynasty Equity are also passive investors in Liverpool after injecting £164m into the club in 2023 in a deal valuing Liverpool at more than $4.5bn.

FSG were known as New England Sports Ventures when they paid £300m for Liverpool in October 2010 after a tumultuous period under former owners Tom Hicks and George Gillett.

The deal - which was first reported on at the end of last month - has accelerated at a rapid pace. Now that everything has been agreed, the closing of the transaction will happen after regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions are met.

Facebook co-founder Eduardo Saverin and his wife Elaine are also part of the syndicate of investors. Saverin, 44, was part of a consortium which assembled an unsuccessful takeover bid for Chelsea during the 2022 auction triggered by Vladimir Putin's invasion of Ukraine.

articles.standfirst: La investigación acerca de las 130 irregularidades financieras del conjunto mancuniano todavía no ha finalizado y se sigue esperando el informe final
articles.summary: La investigación acerca de las 130 irregularidades financieras del conjunto mancuniano todavía no ha finalizado y se sigue esperando el informe final
articles.body: Richard Masters, presidente ejecutivo de la Premier League, admitió que la resolución del caso del Manchester City y sus 130 supuestas irregularidades financieras está "alargándose más de lo esperado". En una conversación con la cadena británica BBC, el máximo mandatario de la competición inglesa abordó el caso del City, que fue acusado en febrero de 130 irregularidades financieras y, pese a que el juicio acabó a finales de 2024, aún se desconoce la resolución del mismo. "Acepto que está alargándose más de lo esperado y entiendo que la gente quiere saber lo antes posible qué está pasando, pero es que simplemente no puedo decir nada", señaló Masters. "Nuestras reglas son muy claras: hay que seguir el proceso y solo hay una ruta clara, que es permitir que el proceso llegue a una conclusión natural", añadió el directivo. La Premier League acusó en febrero de 2023 al City de no proporcionar información financiera precisa ni los detalles correctos de pagos a entrenadores y jugadores entre las temporadas 2009-2010 y 2017-2018, de no cumplir con el 'fair play' financiero de la UEFA entre 2009 y 2018 y con el de la Premier League entre la 2015-2016 y la 2017-2018. Así como de no cooperar con las investigaciones de la Premier que tuvieron lugar entre diciembre de 2018 y febrero de 2023. El City ha negado todos los cargos y contrató a algunos de los mejores abogados especializados en deporte en el Reino Unido para tratar de limpiar su nombre y evitar una sanción que podría ir desde una multa económica hasta la deducción de puntos, descenso de categoría e incluso pérdida de títulos.

articles.title: Jamal Musiala: Bayern Munich forward shares health update after collapsing during a match again
articles.summary: Bayern Munich's Jamal Musiala collapses during a game again; the Germany international collapses on the pitch for the second time in four days; Musiala reveals he is suffering from “treatable absence seizures”; the 23-year-old says there is no long-term health risk
articles.body:
The 23-year-old fell to the floor just eight minutes after coming on as a substitute in Bayern's friendly with FC Heidenheim on Tuesday night.

It follows a similar incident in Saturday's friendly against RB Leipzig, but the Germany international says there is no long-term health risk.

He posted on Instagram: "First things first, I am doing well. I am incredibly grateful for your messages and your support!

"I understand that many of you are worried. I would like to put those concerns to rest today and explain the situation: I have been diagnosed with brief, temporary - but treatable - absence seizures resulting from a neurological dysfunction.

"These can lead to the kind of incidents seen recently, such as during the match against Leipzig or the game in Heidenheim.

"I know they might look alarming at first glance, but for me, they are currently part of my everyday life. I am receiving excellent medical care and remain very optimistic. FC Bayern and my personal support network are right by my side, helping me through this.

"Importantly, there is no further health risk involved. In close consultation and regular contact with the experts, it was my personal wish to face this challenge; with the medical clearance of the neurologists, I want to continue doing what helps my recovery most: simply living my life and pursuing my passion for playing football.

"I have taken full responsibility for this decision. Overall, I feel very positive and am on the right track.

"What helps me most on this journey is continuing to chase victories and titles with my team and with your amazing support.

"I hope this helps you understand the situation better. At the same time, I ask for your understanding regarding my wish to keep this matter private, sharing it only with my closest circle, the club, and the medical experts."

articles.body: La mediática influencer Pawgli, pareja del futbolista Pep Chavarría fichado recientemente por el Chelsea, aclara la polémica sobre sus supuestas lágrimas por la marcha del ex del Rayo Vallecano a Londres y su comentario de que "las decisiones correctas también duelen". "Me parece tan denigrante lo que hacéis con los influencers. Yo soy creadora de contenido pero creo que soy súper mega natural con vosotras y si yo estoy mal y no puedo grabar durante días pues intento mostrar cómo estoy y la realidad. ¿No sabéis por qué estaba llorando? Aquí la gente ha sacado sus conclusiones de la manga pero bueno es totalmente válido, no pasa nada", empezó explicando. Pawgli comparte en su cuenta de TikTok que "nadie sabe por qué estaba mal en el vídeo, pero pongamos que estaba mal porque mi novio futbolista se va a Londres y yo me quedo en Madrid. ¿Tú de verdad crees que yo estoy llorando y mal porque tengo que irme a Londres con él y porque no voy a poder estar en Madrid e ir a eventos a que me regalen cosas? ¿Tú de verdad te crees que yo estoy mal por eso?". "No podéis pensar más allá que mi novio como decís es futbolista y gana dinero, pero yo soy creadora de contenido y también gano dinero y tengo mi trabajo en Madrid.En Madrid tengo eventos diarios y no voy porque me regalen cosas, voy porque es mi trabajo y me pagan por ello". subrayó. Pawgli aclaró que "yéndome a Londres estoy como renunciando a no hacer el 100% de mi trabajo. Él tiene su trabajo, yo tengo el mío, él cobra su dinero, yo cobro el mío. Nadie vive de nadie, yo no vivo de mi novio, con lo cual no viviendo en Madrid estoy perdiendo oportunidades y oportunidades de yo seguir creciendo en esto porque está absolutamente todo en Madrid". "Yo quiero seguir conservando mi público español, yo no sé hablar inglés, al menos ahora mismo que es obvio que voy a tener que aprender, pero por más que sepa inglés no quiero cambiar el público y tener un público inglés. Yo quiero seguir con mi público español y por eso para mí es tan bueno en todo que yo viva en Madrid", informó.

articles.title: Big 12 Football Preview and Predictions for 2026 Season
articles.summary: Within a game built for chaos, the Big 12 has become a perennial source of intrigue and unpredictability in college football.
articles.body:
Within a game built for chaos, the Big 12 has become a perennial source of intrigue and unpredictability in college football.

One thing we know, however, is Texas Tech has become the villain.

The reigning league champions had a drama-filled offseason—more on that later—and enter as the clear preseason favorite. The rest of the conference is aiming to track down and displace the Red Raiders in 2026.

As the campaign nears, the expected threats are rivals BYU and Utah. But a rising Houston team, resurgent Kansas State program and Oklahoma State squad are just three of the many candidates in a fascinating Big 12 outlook.

Most national praise lands elsewhere, but the Big 12 has a fun group of QBs. Any of Arizona's Noah Fifita , BYU's Bear Bachmeier , Houston's Conner Weigman , Kansas State's Avery Johnson , Oklahoma State's Drew Mestemaker and Utah's Devon Dampier could be the league's best at the position this year.

Among the numerous options, the Red Raiders have running back Cameron Dickey , tight end Terrance Carter Jr. , defensive tackle A.J. Holmes Jr. , edge-rusher Trey White , linebackers Ben Roberts and Austin Romaine and cornerback Brice Pollock .

Many players from North Texas followed Eric Morris to OSU, including star running back Caleb Hawkins and wideout Wyatt Young . Two other key receivers are Arizona State's Omarion Miller and Houston's Amare Thomas , while BYU's LJ Martin and West Virginia's Cam Cook are standout backs.

Cincinnati left guard Evan Tengesdahl is a returning AP All-American, as is Colorado wide receiver Danny Scudero after transferring from San Jose State. Utah safety Jackson Bennee is among the nation's most versatile players.

Backed by well-funded boosters, Texas Tech has become one of college football's most active programs in the transfer portal. Fair or not, that has made the Red Raiders a villain to some. The school's public defense of quarterback Brendan Sorsby during the gambling-related backlash added to the scrutiny and further fueled that perception. If Texas Tech drops a game in 2026, the reaction will be loud. But if the Red Raiders overpower the Big 12 again, the angst will be palpable.

Back in 2011 and 2012, Collin Klein helped K-State hit double-digit wins, claim a conference title and make a prestigious bowl appearance while also finishing third in Heisman Trophy voting as a senior. Pretty good résumé! Now, the former offensive coordinator at K-State and Texas A&M is getting his shot as the head coach of his alma mater—with a QB, Avery Johnson, who plays a bit like Klein himself.

Through two seasons of the 12-team College Football Playoff era, only the Big 12 winner has represented the league in the championship tournament. That was Arizona State in 2024 and Texas Tech last season. Can the Big 12 finally become a two-bid league in 2026?

As if I needed more reason to believe in Texas Tech, the schedule looks wildly favorable, too. BYU and Utah are slated for a showdown in early November, and the winner of that matchup should be a prime Big 12 contender.

Tier 2: Arizona, Houston, Kansas State and TCU

It can hardly be overstated how much the conference is a wonderful mess. Arizona and Houston both tallied nine wins in the regular season last year, ending on the doorstep of the league title game. Kansas State has a soft schedule, it appears, while TCU's upside is compelling if the transfers click.

Tier 3: Arizona State and Oklahoma State

Speaking of transfers, these programs had a busy offseason in the portal. ASU has a difficult slate, considering it travels to Texas Tech, BYU and Arizona. Oklahoma State's level of turnover makes it tough to predict, too. But at their best, both rosters could ascend in the Big 12 race.

The warmest seat is found at Baylor, where Dave Aranda has posted a 22-28 record since winning the Big 12 and finishing 12-2 in 2021. Worse yet, Baylor has ended with a 4-5 conference mark or worse in three of those four seasons.

Cincinnati has improved its record every year under Scott Satterfield , but a third straight second-half collapse could doom his tenure.

From there, the discussion is fascinating.

Kansas would not actually consider moving on from Lance Leipold , right? The program was horrendous prior to his arrival, but would missing bowl eligibility for a third year in a row be problematic?

Meanwhile, the Deion Sanders era at Colorado seems to be trending toward an uninspired end. The question, if CU struggles again, is how much the headlines are worth to a program fighting for on-field relevance.

Sep. 5: Auburn vs. Baylor (in Atlanta) Sep. 12: Oregon at Oklahoma State Sep. 12: Arkansas at Utah Sep. 19: Tulane at Kansas State Oct. 17: Notre Dame at BYU

In the early stages of nonconference action, Baylor and Utah are slated to take on SEC teams. Oklahoma State is set to meet Oregon for a massive test of the Pokes' revamped roster, and K-State hosts Tulane—a Playoff team in 2025. BYU's national reputation could be at stake when Notre Dame comes to Provo, too.

Sep. 18: Houston at Texas Tech Oct. 3: BYU at TCU Oct. 10: Houston at Kansas State Oct. 17: Arizona State at Texas Tech Nov. 7: BYU at Utah

Houston has a prove-it opportunity at Texas Tech in Week 3, and that result will influence early expectations. Otherwise, the conference has many potential swing games leading to 2026's edition of the Holy War between BYU and Utah.

Sep. 12: Arizona at BYU Oct. 31: Arizona State at BYU Nov. 7: Oklahoma State at Kansas State Nov. 21: Utah at TCU Nov. 26: Texas Tech at TCU

If you align with the belief of "we basically know nothing" about the Big 12—and I wouldn't blame you at all—you could plug any matchup here. These selections lean on key opportunities for presumed second- and third-tier teams.

Given the excellence of the North Texas offense under Eric Morris last season, it's not a bold prediction to say Oklahoma State's scoring attack will thrive. After all, many of those players followed him to Stillwater.

Nevertheless, the jump in competition is real. There's certainly no guarantee that OSU destroys the scoreboard in 2026.

The ceiling of this offense is enormous, though.

Drew Mestemaker paced the FBS with 4,379 passing yards last season, tossing 34 touchdowns to nine interceptions. Caleb Hawkins ranked third at 1,804 yards from scrimmage and accounted for 29 scores, and Wyatt Young also finished third with 1,264 receiving yards. That's a heck of a foundational trio.

Look, the whole unit is basically an ode to transfers. When we talk about revamping a roster, Oklahoma State has a completely rebuilt team.

But it might just be outrageous enough to work—and work well.

Between the overall talent on the roster and what seems like a soft slate, Texas Tech should have an elite defense again.

And last season, it was a phenomenal group.

Texas Tech generated a nation-best 32 takeaways and yielded an FBS-low 3.9 yards per snap. The unit ranked third nationally with 11.8 points allowed per game, including only three opponents scoring more than 17.

In 2026, the Red Raiders return All-Big 12 selections in defensive tackle A.J. Holmes Jr., linebacker Ben Roberts and corner Brice Pollock. Additionally, edge-rushers Trey White, Adam Trick and Jamond Mathis, defensive tackle Julien Laventure and linebacker Austin Romaine were all-conference picks at their previous stop.

As if that's not enough, the secondary is loaded with corner Amier Boyd, safety Brenden Jordan and hybrid defender John Curry.

The offense has a few questions to answer, but it'll be tough to score on Tech.

Projected Title Game: Texas Tech vs. BYU

The boring pick doubles as a reasonable one.

Not only would this be a clash of the most-respected teams entering the year, but it's also a rematch of the 2025 Big 12 Championship Game. A fearless prediction, I know.

That feeling aside, I simply don't see Texas Tech wasting its favorable outlook. As long as QB Will Hammond is healthy soon, a competent offense would likely be all the Red Raiders—because of their defensive potential—need to excel.

BYU's unproven receiving corps is a concern, but experience is scattered all around the rest of its roster. This should be a 10-win team for a third straight year, and BYU could secure its first conference crown since the 2007 Mountain West title.

The villain, however, is built to continue its Big 12 reign.

Tijjani Reijnders, sólo un año después de aterrizar en el Etihad Stadium, abandona el Manchester City en dirección a un Al Qadsiah que ha pagado más de 60 millones para hacerse con los servicios del centrocampista neerlandés. "Tuvo una actuación realmente buena. Es un chico encantador que ha dejado huella desde el primer día. Fue excepcional en el Milan y con la selección de Países Bajos. Sabíamos que sería un fichaje clave para el Manchester City de cara a los próximos años. Es uno de los mejores fichajes en la historia del club", llegó a decir Guardiola tras su debut en Premier. Llegaba con la idea de ir rejuveneciendo la sala de máquinas de un Manchester City que, progresivamente, fue perdiendo a Gündogan, De Bruyne... y sabía que Bernardo Silva, como acabó sucediendo, podía dejar el club a final de temporada una vez finalizado su contrato. Su debut, desde luego, fue tremendamente ilusionante... aunque ya había hecho sus 'pinitos' en el Mundial de Clubes. Arrancó como titular contra el Wolverhampton en la primera jornada de la Premier, marcó el segundo gol del partido y asistió a Haaland en el tercero. Sin embargo, fue perdiendo peso con el paso de los meses y no tuvo participación en siete de los últimos 10 partidos del curso. No le impidió acudir al Mundial con Países Bajos. Ahora bien, ante las dudas que generó su rendimiento durante su primera temporada en el Etihad, el Manchester City ha preferido no sólo recuperar la inversión que realizó un año atrás para ficharlo desde el Milan por 55 millones... sino sacarle hasta beneficio. De este modo, sumado al adiós de Rodri Hernández y el propio Bernardo Silva, la salida de Reijnders no hace otra cosa que seguir aumentando el agujero del Manchester City en el centro del campo. Ahora mismo, con el fichaje de Elliot Anderson, el más caro de su historia, el conjunto 'cityzen' sólo cuenta con tres jugadores para el doble pivote... a la espera de ver si terminan de lanzarse por Bouaddi.

articles.title: Heisman Candidate LaNorris Sellers Interning at Local Driving Range During Fall Semester
articles.summary: When he's not on a football field this fall, you might find South Carolina quarterback LaNorris Sellers on the range.
articles.body:
When he's not on a football field this fall, you might find South Carolina quarterback LaNorris Sellers on the range.

According to Hale McGranahan of Gamecock247, Sellers is interning The Par Tee Golf Center in West Columbia, South Carolina. It's the only college coursework he has to worry about for the time being as he has no classes on his academic schedule.

Sellers is majoring in sport and entertainment management, and he's on his way toward graduating in December.

A previous internship took him to Contract Construction, the South Carolina-based company that's working on the renovations to Williams-Brice Stadium.

"I sat in with a lot of those meetings at the stadium, the group out of Oklahoma that they gave the job to build the stadium, do the design and all that, I met with them," Sellers said of his time there. "I pretty much knew what was going on over there before a lot of people did."

His tasks at Par Tee are far more menial. He told McGrahanan he mostly performs "facility management," such as mowing the grass and picking up golf balls.

While he's out on the range, Sellers presumably takes the chance to mentally go over the Gamecocks' offensive scheme or think about areas of his own game to improve.

South Carolina didn't make the Associated Press Top 25 poll , but challenging for the College Football Playoff isn't out of the question .

A lot will hinge on the performance of Sellers, who threw for 2,437 yards, 13 touchdowns and eight interceptions in 2025.

His individual tools are off the charts . If he puts together a big year, he could enter the Heisman Trophy conversation and perhaps climb into the first round on 2027 NFL draft boards.

articles.title: Former Wisconsin TE Jack Pugh Died from Acute Bronchopneumonia, Coroner's Report Says
articles.summary: Former Wisconsin tight end Jack Pugh's death resulted from acute bronchopneumonia, a type of pneumonia, according to a coroner's report.
articles.body:
Former Wisconsin tight end Jack Pugh's death resulted from acute bronchopneumonia, a type of pneumonia, according to a coroner's report.

The Franklin County (Ohio) Coroner's Office said the 24-year-old Pugh, who died March 30, had this lung infection due to cardiomyopathy with hepatosplenomegaly. Cardiomyopathy is a disease that reduces the heart's ability to pump blood. Hepatosplenomegaly is the result of an enlarged liver and spleen.

People magazine on Tuesday was first to report the coroner's report on Pugh's death.

Pugh who was from Columbus, Ohio, redshirted in 2021 before appearing in one game for Wisconsin and earning academic All-Big Ten honors in 2022. He announced in an Instagram post in December 2023 that he had decided before that season to medically retire from the game of football.

"My physical health was not near perfect, but my mental health was the reason I decided to hang it up," Pugh said in that Instagram post. "Over years of prolonged depression and substance abuse, I decided I deserved a better life and to finally find happiness. In no way was football the root of these problems, but everything in my life had distracted me for so long to the point I never had prioritized my mental health all along, digging a deeper darker hole."

After Pugh died, Wisconsin's football program said in a social media post that "Jack was a positive light and brought a genuine spirit to our football program. More than that, he cared about people and was loved by his teammates and staff."

Pugh had earned his degree from Wisconsin last year.

articles.title: College Fantasy Football Rankings: Top 300 players for drafts

articles.body:
Welcome to Yahoo College Fantasy Football ! With these top-300 rankings, I'm focusing on a 1QB scoring system, since that is the default setting on Yahoo. The 68-team presents a far more extensive player pool to choose from than in NFL fantasy. So even if each manager in a 12-team league rosters three quarterbacks (Yahoo default is 18 roster spots), that still leaves 32 other streamable options rotating through the wire to plug into the lineup when injuries or byes crop up. It's also important to note with just 12 quarterbacks starting on a weekly basis, you only get one shot at producing a big score out of your starting signal-caller. While it might be worth it to reach for an elite quarterback like Arch Manning or Trinidad Chambliss in your draft, there will be plenty of suitable options down the board to sift through while stockpiling running backs and wideouts.

The Hero RB ethos is alive and well in Power Four CFF leagues, and should comprise most of the Round 1 and 2 selections until the well starts to dry up in Round 4, at which point the wide receivers and top-3 elite tight ends will become the priority. Be mindful of shared backfields in powerful offenses like Oregon, Indiana and Texas. It's not a bad idea to corner both potential starting options, before jettisoning whichever RB takes the backseat when bye weeks hit. The same can be said for wide receivers, where there is significant variance between the preseason rankings and final scoring leaders. You should focus on acquiring either a true target-hog WR1 in a decent passing offense, or a top-3 WR on the depth chart in a pass-heavy, air raid-style offense that produces massive numbers through the air and is capable of supporting two starting-caliber wideouts. Many times, the preseason WR2 or 3 in those dynamic passing offenses become the primary option, and can be acquired at a fraction of the draft capital.

Turnovers and losses are weighed heavily and will drastically affect how your Team Offense position performs through the season. Indiana, Ohio State, Notre Dame and Texas Tech will be priorities because of their loaded rosters and relatively easy schedules.

articles.title: Deputy Tried to Serve Civil Papers to Deion Sanders at Colorado Practice, but Coach Was Unavailable
articles.summary: A deputy with the Boulder County Sheriff's Office showed up at the University of Colorado campus last week to serve civil papers to Deion Sanders while the coach was at an open practice and inaccessible.
articles.body:
A deputy with the Boulder County Sheriff's Office showed up at the University of Colorado campus last week to serve civil papers to Deion Sanders while the coach was at an open practice and inaccessible.

The officer was informed that the Buffaloes coach was "unavailable at the time to receive receipt of the papers," a spokesperson with the sheriff's office said Wednesday. Sanders is being subpoenaed to testify as part of a bankruptcy trial involving his son, Shilo, that begins on Aug. 31, according to USA Today.

The Colorado athletic department had no additional information. The Buffaloes open the season on Sept. 3 at Georgia Tech.

The deputy arrived on campus at 10:22 a.m. on Aug. 11 with civil papers. It was the day the Buffaloes held an open practice with specific rules in place that nothing observed could be reported, published or shared.

Carrie Haverfield, a senior communications specialist for the sheriff's office, wrote in an email to The Associated Press that it's not uncommon for civil papers to take several attempts to serve.

"While working with university staff to find a better time to complete the process, we heard from Mr. Sanders' legal counsel who indicated that they were able to receive receipt of the papers on behalf of Mr. Sanders, however, they were not located in Boulder County, so we transferred the paperwork to Denver to be served," Haverfield wrote. "We did not find any university staff to be attempting to block the civil service, on the contrary, they were attempting to help our deputy find a better time to do so. We do not disclose the specific contents of civil papers that we serve."

Shilo Sanders remains in litigation over a lawsuit stemming from an incident with a security guard when he was in high school. The guard filed a lawsuit against Sanders and was issued a default judgment when Sanders didn't show for his court date.

The hard-hitting safety who played for his dad at Colorado was waived by the Tampa Bay Buccaneers last August.

articles.title: Alabama, Tennessee Reportedly Set to Renew Historic Uniform Matchup for 2026, 2027 SEC Games
articles.summary: Alabama and Tennessee are reportedly planning to revive a longstanding tradition in their historic rivalry.
articles.body:
Alabama and Tennessee are reportedly planning to revive a longstanding tradition in their historic rivalry.

According to ESPN's Pete Thamel, the Crimson Tide and the Vols will both wear their home jerseys during their SEC matchups in 2026 and 2027. It will be the first time since 1970 that they will wear Alabama crimson and Tennessee orange in their rivalry game.

The rivalry between Alabama and Tennessee dates back over a century, with the Crimson Tide leading the all-time series 60-40-8. Still, the Vols' 40 wins are the most victories over Alabama of any program in college football.

The two teams have traded wins in each of the last four seasons, with Alabama taking home a 37-20 victory in 2025. They will meet on Oct. 17 this year.

articles.title: Boise State Reveals Hand-Painted 40th Anniversary Football Helmets in New Photos
articles.summary: Boise State unveiled new football helmets celebrating the 40th anniversary of the team's blue turf at Albertsons Stadium on Wednesday.
articles.body:
Boise State unveiled new football helmets celebrating the 40th anniversary of the team's blue turf at Albertsons Stadium on Wednesday.

The hand-painted helmets contain a throwback logo on the left side and the number "40" on the right side, utilizing a textured design similar to The Blue.

Seven hashmarks are also visible on the top of the helmet, representing each installation of The Blue.

The Broncos will use the helmets during their home opener against Memphis on Sept. 12.

The helmets were created by artist Armando Villarreal, who discussed the process that led to the design.

"As an artist, opportunities like this don't come around often," Villarreal said, per the school's announcement . "The Blue is one of the most recognizable symbols in college football, and being asked to create a helmet that honors its 40-year legacy was both an incredible privilege and a responsibility. I wanted every brushstroke and every detail to tell the story of how one bold idea transformed Boise State into a brand known around the world. My hope is that when fans see this helmet, they don't just see artwork, but see the history, pride, innovation and the generations of Bronco fans who made The Blue legendary."

Boise State is no stranger to introducing hand-painted alternate helmets, previously doing so ahead of its 2025 campaign.

After making a 2024 College Football Playoff appearance, the Broncos finished at 9-5 during their 2025 season under head coach Spencer Danielson.

As Boise State now prepares for its first year in the Pac-12, it'll look to start off on a high note against Memphis. Kickoff on Sept. 12 is at 6 p.m. ET.

articles.title: El Bodo quiere que la Champions vuelva a pasar por el Círculo Polar
articles.standfirst: El conjunto noruego se impuso a domicilio al NEC Nimega (1-3) en la ida de la última ronda previa de la Liga de Campeones
articles.summary: El conjunto noruego se impuso a domicilio al NEC Nimega (1-3) en la ida de la última ronda previa de la Liga de Campeones
articles.body: El Bodo/Glimt hizo historia en la pasada Champions. No sólo clasificó para disputar la fase liga por primera vez... sino que llegó hasta octavos de final tras eliminar al Inter en los 'playoffs'. Ahora bien, no quieren que se quede en una mera anécdota. El objetivo es que la Liga de Campeones vuelva a pasar por el Círculo Polar y, tras imponerse al NEC Nimega (1-3) en Países Bajos en la ida de la última ronda previa, ha dejado la eliminatoria bastante encarrilada. Emre Mor, autor del gol de la clasificación contra el Olympiacos de Mendilibar saliendo desde el banquillo, se ganó arrancar de titular en un NEC Nimega donde Tadic también fue de la partida. En el Bodo/Glimt, Berg llevaba la manija en el centro del campo y Hauge acaparaba miradas en banda izquierda. Ya a los 10' se llevó el primer aviso serio el NEC Nimega con un penalti en contra que tuvo que ser corregido por el VAR a causa de una falta previa de Hauge a la hora de controlar el balón. Tenía claro el Bodo que el partido pasaba por no exponerse en exceso y salir al contragolpe. En el 17', de hecho, Crettaz le sacó una mano excelente a Helmersen tras un centro lateral a cargo de Blomberg. Fue a partir de entonces cuando parecía que el NEC Nimega comenzaba a hacer pie en el partido. Sin exponerse tanto como de costumbre, sí se adueñaron de la posesión. Emre Mor ponía la calidad en derecha y cada envío de Tadic llevaba peligro. Haikin, incluso, tuvo que quitarse de encima a córner un disparo fuerte al primer palo desde la frontal a cargo de Chery. Había sido la primera ocasión relevante por parte del NEC Nimega. Pero, a los 24', el Bodo les castigó saliendo al contragolpe. Robó Fet en campo propio, Hauge condujo la acción y metió un envío al primer palo que fue convertido de primeras por el propio Fet con un remate a ras de suelo. Haikin le volvió a sacar una gran mano a Chery, mientras Bjortuf se fue agigantando en la defensa del área. Intentó reponerse el NEC Nimega antes de finalizar la primera parte. Pero, a tres minutos para el descanso, Blomberg recibió otro envío de Hauge y sacó a bailar a un Storm que acabó cometiendo penalti. Se lo pidió Helmersen... y no falló. Partidos Champions (ida última ronda previa) El Bodo no quiso perder la inercia con la que finalizó la primera parte y salió decidido a por el tercer. Lo encontró apenas cinco minutos después de regresar del vestuario. Berg sacó a relucir el guante que tiene en su pierna derecha y puso un centro desde el banderín de córner que Aleesami, de forma bastante forzada, cabeceó al fondo de la red. Lo pudieron dejar prácticamente visto para sentencia. Sin embargo, dieron un pequeño paso atrás que hizo aparecer a Haikin y, a cinco minutos para el final del partido, el NEC Nimega volvió a meterse en la eliminatoria. Tahaui la puso desde banda derecha, Tadic peinó y Bischoff remachó en el segundo palo. La renta es buena. Pero el Bodo quedó petrificado con el remate al poste del propio Bischoff. El Celtic, gracias al doblete de Camilo Durán y el tanto inicial de Nygren, goleó al LASK (3-0) y dejó la eliminatoria prácticamente resuelta para la vuelta en Austria. El Celje sacó un valioso empate a domicilio contra el Slovan Bratislava de Yaya Touré (1-1) y el Hapoel Be'er Sheva acabó remontando en casa frente al Sabah (2-1).
